description: This file defines the 'Creatable' interface in the OpenMRS project, which provides method signatures for tracking creation metadata (creator and creation date) for domain objects.

classes.name: Creatable
classes.description: An interface for domain objects that need to track information related to when they were created and by whom.

methods.name: getCreator
methods.description: Returns the user who created the object.

methods.name: setCreator
methods.description: Sets the user who created the object.

methods.name: getDateCreated
methods.description: Returns the date the object was created.

methods.name: setDateCreated
methods.description: Sets the date the object was created.
